inference: exact released reference encoder, posterior encoder, flow, and generator topology
restricted weights-only conversion of the hash-pinned release pickle
strict steady-state Safetensors reload and portable export
training: raw source, target, and optional reference waveform preparation
limitations: The upstream repository publishes no converter training loop, discriminator, dataset, or loss; VoiceHub's paired reconstruction objective is explicitly reconstructed.
The converter clones tone color only; accent, emotion, rhythm, and linguistic content come from the base speech.
The upstream Silero/Whisper reference segmenters are not used. Provide trimmed speech or run a VoiceHub-native VAD explicitly.
Native text-to-speech composition requires a VoiceHub-native base model or caller-supplied base waveform and is separate from the converter graph.
No corpus-level similarity or audio-quality improvement is claimed.
